NEOWS_BLESSING.title: Neow's Blessing
NEOWS_BLESSING.description: Grants the player their standard Neow's relic reward at the start of a custom run.
ENCHANTER.title: Enchanter
ENCHANTER.description: Card rewards have a random enchantment.
PHALANX.title: Phalanx
PHALANX.description: Enemies gain [gold]Barricade[/gold] and [gold]Plating[/gold] at the start of combat.
COLORLESS_CARDS.title: Colorless Cards
COLORLESS_CARDS.description: Colorless cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
MARATHON.title: Marathon
MARATHON.description: Maps are longer, with fewer rest sites and more elites.
PAUPER.title: Pauper
LONE_WOLF.title: Lone Wolf
LONE_WOLF.description: Combat encounters are scaled as if playing with [red]2[/red] players.
BODY_DOUBLE.title: Body Double
BODY_DOUBLE.description: Remove all starting Attacks. Add [blue]1[/blue] upgraded [gold]Body Slam[/gold] with [purple]Clone[/purple]. Attacks cannot be drafted or bought.
PRAISE_SNECKO.title: Praise Snecko
HUBRIS.title: Hubris
HUBRIS.description: Start the game with [red]1[/red] max HP.
POLYMATH.title: Polymath
POLYMATH.description: Start the game with the starter relic of all characters.
EPHEMERAL.title: Ephemeral
EPHEMERAL.description: All cards gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold]. (Does not affect Status, Curse, or Quest cards.)
CHIMERA.title: Chimera
CHIMERA.description: Your starting deck is a fusion of all characters.
RUNIC_DOME.title: Runic Dome
RUNIC_DOME.description: Gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy at the start of each turn. You can no longer see enemy Intents.
URGENCY.title: Urgency
URGENCY.description: Every second spent in combat beyond [red]60[/red] seconds deals damage to you.
URGENCY_PLUS.title: Urgency+
URGENCY_PLUS.description: Every second spent in combat beyond [red]45[/red] seconds deals damage to you.
URGENCY_PLUS_PLUS.title: Urgency++
URGENCY_PLUS_PLUS.description: Every second spent in combat beyond [red]30[/red] seconds deals damage to you.
SPEEDRUN.title: Speedrun
SPEEDRUN.description: If the run timer exceeds [red]40[/red] minutes, you lose.
SPEEDRUN_PLUS.title: Speedrun+
SPEEDRUN_PLUS.description: If the run timer exceeds [red]30[/red] minutes, you lose.
SPEEDRUN_PLUS_PLUS.title: Speedrun++
SPEEDRUN_PLUS_PLUS.description: If the run timer exceeds [red]20[/red] minutes, you lose.
RELIC_SWAP.title: Relic Swap
RELIC_SWAP.description: Swap your starter relic with a random rare relic.
HIGH_ROLLER.title: High Roller
HIGH_ROLLER.description: Start with [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Jackpot[/gold] and [red]1[/red] [gold]Debt[/gold] in your deck.
SPRINT.title: Sprint
SPRINT.description: The map is a single linear path with [blue]1[/blue] of each room type.
ENEMY_SCALING.title: Enemy Scaling
